mapper.select: SELECT p.id AS portfolio_id, p.name AS portfolio_name, p.risk_level, p.strategy_type AS portfolio_strategy_type, p.listed, p.status, p.reject_reason, s.strategyid AS strategy_id, s.name AS strategy_name, s.strategy_type, s.description, s.strategy_ref_id, p.created_at, s.scale, s.funds, s.fee_rate, s.return_rate, s.annual_return, s.volatility, s.sharpe_ratio, s.max_drawdown, s.win_rate FROM portfolios p LEFT JOIN strategies s ON p.strategy_id = s.strategy_ref_id ORDER BY p.id DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE portfolios SET listed = 1, status = 'approved', reject_reason = NULL, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND listed = 0
UPDATE portfolios SET listed = -1, status = 'rejected', reject_reason = #{reason}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO portfolios (name, risk_level, strategy_type, summary, target_investor, strategy_id, listed, status, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{name}, #{riskLevel}, #{strategyType}, #{summary}, #{targetInvestor}, #{strategyId}, 0, 'draft', NOW(), NOW())
mapper.update: UPDATE portfolios SET name = #{name}, risk_level = #{riskLevel}, strategy_type = #{strategyType}, summary = #{summary}, target_investor = #{targetInvestor}, strategy_id = #{strategyId}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT id, name, risk_level, strategy_type, summary, target_investor, strategy_id, listed, status, created_at, updated_at FROM portfolios WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.update: UPDATE portfolios SET status = #{status}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
